lore: Surveyor Odile paints three lines on every island's hull before the cargo boats come in: a white line where its lamp would turn amber, a red line where it would sink below budget, and a long blue line along the whole harbour wall where the world could no longer keep every island afloat at once. Bring her a cargo list and she will tell you, before a single crate is loaded, whether the islands stay afloat.

lines.afloat: Every hull rides above its lines. Load away.
lines.awash: That cargo puts an island over its white line. She will float, but her lamp turns amber.
lines.sunk: That cargo sinks her past the red line, or the harbour wall cannot hold the world. Leave it on the quay.
